## @kit/result
export type Awaitable<T> = T | Promise<T>;
export type Err<E> = {
    readonly ok: false;
    readonly error: E;
};
export type IgnoreReason<S extends string> = string extends S ? never : S extends '' ? never : S;
export type Ok<T> = {
    readonly ok: true;
    readonly value: T;
};
export type Result<T, E> = Ok<T> | Err<E>;
export function all<T, E>(results: readonly Result<T, E>[]): Result<T[], E>
export function andThen<T, U, E, F>(result: Result<T, E>, fn: (value: T) => Result<U, F>): Result<U, E | F>
export function andThenAsync<T, U, E, F>(result: Awaitable<Result<T, E>>, fn: (value: T) => Awaitable<Result<U, F>>): Promise<Result<U, E | F>>
export function assertNever(value: never, context: string): never
export function err<E>(error: E): Err<E>
export function fromPromise<T, E>(promise: PromiseLike<T> | (() => PromiseLike<T>), onThrow: (cause: unknown) => E): Promise<Result<T, E>>
export function ignore<S extends string>(_result: Result<unknown, unknown> | PromiseLike<Result<unknown, unknown>>, _reason: IgnoreReason<S>): void
export function isErr<T, E>(result: Result<T, E>): result is Err<E>
export function isOk<T, E>(result: Result<T, E>): result is Ok<T>
export function map<T, U, E>(result: Result<T, E>, fn: (value: T) => U): Result<U, E>
export function ok(): Ok<void>
export function ok<T>(value: T): Ok<T>
export function parseJson(text: string): Result<unknown, SyntaxError>
export function tryCatch<T, E>(fn: () => T, onThrow: (cause: unknown) => E): Result<T, E>
export function unwrapOr<T, E>(result: Result<T, E>, fallback: T): T
